PASS | short yield returns session_id and write_stdin-style poll completes | initial_session_id=2
PASS | fault injection: local command survives lost initial MCP response |
PASS | no public rediscovery API in ProcessSessionManager |
PASS | lost response after local mutation | client_error=UND_ERR_SOCKET local_file=agent-change
PASS | blind retry can overwrite newer state when no version/precondition is supplied |
#303 fixes the model-facing snake_case/yield contract and the normal session flow.
It does not by itself resolve the separate case where a local operation commits but the MCP response is
lost; the caller can still lose the session handle or become uncertain whether a mutation committed.
